diagnosis: Customer missed events during an outage and wants to replay them. Per kb-0015, manual replay is only available for seven days after failed delivery, so a two-week-old outage falls outside the replay window. No policy escalation required.
reply: Thanks for reaching out. Our webhook system retries failed deliveries six times over roughly an hour. After those automatic retries, the event remains available for manual replay for seven days. Because your outage spanned two weeks, the events from that period are unfortunately outside the seven-day replay window and can no longer be replayed. If you experience another outage, replaying within that seven-day period will let you recover missed deliveries.
